title: Store, config and ID allocation
lead:
Read and write record files in the store directory, load the config, and
allocate the next ID by scanning the store.
findings_note: PROJECT.md Architecture sketch (ID allocation, Determinism); Open decisions 4, 6, 7
boundary:
**Not in this slice:** collision detection and renumbering (the ID collision
slice), and any command other than library calls.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Milestone 1 covers read/write and ID allocation. Every command needs one store
API that returns records in a stable order.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
The `store` module from the Architecture sketch, the config loader, and tests
that use temp directories.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- In an empty store the first ID is 1; the filename is `NNNN-slug.<ext>`
  (zero-padded ID, slug from the title).
- The next ID is one past the highest ID found by scanning the store.
- The store path comes from the config, defaulting to `decisions/` at the repo
  root (C20).
- Listing records returns them in a stable, deterministic order.
- Per-repo scope only (C19).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Implement the store and config per C17, C19 and C20 as confirmed. Gap:
PROJECT.md does not say the config file's name or format; follow the record
format decision or ask the owner.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
